sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Anxious, furious, disposed to fight. Head-
ache better by vomiting. Ringing in ears.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Ulcerative inflammation of mouth. Ton-
gue red or bluish-red.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Loss of appetite. Obstinate constipa-
tion.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Persistent choking cough with copious
expectoration. Hoarseness, constriction of chest. Diffi-
cult breathing.
